title: Dunhuang
subtitle: A religious and textual crossroads on the Silk Road
shortSummary: Dunhuang connects Buddhist art, textual preservation, travel routes and multilingual culture.
curatorialDescription: Dunhuang keeps the Chang'an exhibition from becoming a story of an imperial centre alone. Texts, images and travellers preserved, translated and reorganised knowledge at a frontier crossroads.
researchNote: This is an Alpha city-and-region place. Caves, the Library Cave, routes and multilingual sources will be added in the next content batch.
